notes: Form 1040 Line 13b: Schedule 1-A deductions. Explicitly closed-absent for this milestone's bounded supported class (Track 0 Sec 2/7) - never a silent zero default; this citation-backed rule is the named, published authority for the zero. Repair round 3 finding 2: this rule previously gated on mere presence of filing_status (true for every return in existence, not a genuine Schedule-1-A-absence declaration). It now gates on a mandatory (never optional_default) taxpayer assertion, tax.us.2025.schedule1a.no-additional-deductions-declared == "yes", mirroring the f1098 taxpayer-authority-fact pattern; its absence blocks DEPENDENCY_ABSENT rather than silently publishing zero. The taxpayer assertion is now the zero-valued publication's real evidence anchor (ADR-0014 decision 5's zero-evidence requirement), replacing the bare filing_status presence check.
